comment: Thunderkin Awakener (attack: return an Elemental creature card with toughness < its own, tapped and attacking; sacrifice it at the next end step) -- the graveyard CONTESTED between unearth and the trigger. T3, four untapped Mountains, Thunderkin in hand (1/2 haste), Hellspark Elemental (3/1, unearth {1}{R}) and Spark Elemental (3/1) in the graveyard, the opponent at 7. Only unearth Hellspark ({1}{R}) + cast Thunderkin ({1}{R}) + the trigger returning SPARK attacks for 3 + 1 + 3 = 7 (win T3). Returning Hellspark with the trigger instead (no unearth left to make) deals 4; casting only Thunderkin deals 4.
